note: Live-session recording of the SharePoint episode screens (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded. Set MG_TENANT, MG_UPN_DOMAIN and MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID in the environment before queueing (never in a file). Sign-ins are device-code, done by the owner. Episodes 1-9 chain: set MG_KEEP_CHAIN=1 while recording them in order so teardown keeps what the next episode uses; unset it for a full clean-up. The Confidential sensitivity label must be created and synced at least a day before (Purview + Entra EnableMIPLabels); put its GUID in MG_LABEL_ID. Adding 'Everyone except external users' as site visitors is a manual browser step (see the eeeu screen).
prepare: if (-not $env:MG_TENANT -or -not $env:MG_UPN_DOMAIN -or -not $env:MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID) { throw 'Set MG_TENANT (lab tenant short name), MG_UPN_DOMAIN (sign-in domain of the lab users) and MG_PNP_CLIENT_ID (the MG Lab PnP app) in the environment first' }
if (-not $env:MG_LABEL_ID) { throw 'Set MG_LABEL_ID to the Confidential label GUID (Get-Label, never shown on screen)' }

screens.name: eeeu
steps: Set-up (not shown): Settings > Site permissions > Share site, add 'Everyone except external users' with Read (it lands in Site visitors)
Select 'Advanced permissions settings' and show Alex Demo with Full Control
mask: tenant host in the address bar (pipeline/mask.js)
account avatar and display name in the top bar
any real names in the people lists
screens.note: If the people picker hides the claim, skip it and note that GV007 will not appear.

screens.name: admin-center
steps: Open SharePoint admin center > Sites > Active sites
Add the columns 'Sensitivity' and 'External sharing' if they are not shown
Hold on the Contoso Purchasing row: Confidential, Only people in your organization
Optional: select the row, open the details pane > Policies tab

admin account in the top bar
all other site names and URLs
